categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. (UIH) primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of high-end medical imaging diagnostic equipment and radiation therapy devices. Its product portfolio includes Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), X-ray imaging systems (XR), Molecular Imaging (PET/CT, PET/MR), Radiation Therapy (RT) equipment, and life science instruments. The company also provides maintenance services and develops medical imaging software and digital healthcare solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: UIH has developed proprietary core technologies including superconducting magnets for MRI, high-performance gradient coils, digital power amplifiers, silicon photomultiplier (SiPM) based PET detectors, and integrated CT-guided linear accelerators for radiotherapy. The company employs advanced manufacturing methods such as vacuum potting for gradient coils, high-frequency inverter technology for X-ray generators, and digital imaging reconstruction algorithms enhanced by AI. It maintains vertical integration with self-developed key components and a platform-based R&D model to accelerate innovation and product iteration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are hospitals, medical research institutions, and universities, including over 1,000 top-tier hospitals in China. It serves clinical and research applications in oncology, neurology, cardiology, and other medical fields. UIH's products are used globally in over 65 countries, targeting both developed markets like North America and Europe and emerging markets in Asia, Africa, and Latin America. The company supports national health initiatives such as China's Healthy China strategy and regional medical center construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: UIH operates extensively in China with a strong presence in tier-1 hospitals and expanding coverage in county-level and regional medical institutions. Internationally, it has established subsidiaries and sales networks in the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, covering over 60 countries. The company has production bases in Shanghai, Wuhan, Changzhou, and Houston (USA), and regional headquarters in key overseas markets to support localized sales and service.
categories.supply_chain_position: UIH operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of complete medical imaging and radiotherapy systems. It also develops core components and software in-house, ensuring vertical integration and control over critical technologies. The company manages a global supply chain network to support production and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a focus on original technology breakthroughs, autonomous equipment innovation, and integrated medical service models. Key R&D directions include AI integration, 5G, IoT, and cloud-native platforms for intelligent imaging and radiotherapy. UIH invests heavily in next-generation products such as ultra-high field MRI, total-body PET/CT, CT-guided linear accelerators, and digital molecular imaging. It fosters deep collaboration with global academic, clinical, and research institutions to accelerate translational medicine and precision diagnostics.
categories.revenue_model: UIH generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical imaging and radiotherapy equipment, including MRI, CT, XR, PET/CT, PET/MR, and RT systems. Additional revenue streams include maintenance and repair services, software licensing, and digital healthcare solutions. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distributor channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: UIH competes with leading global medical equipment manufacturers such as GE Healthcare, Siemens Healthineers, Philips Healthcare, Varian, and Elekta, as well as domestic competitors like Mindray, Neusoft Medical, and Wandong Medical. It holds a leading position in the Chinese market, ranking among the top in MRI, CT, PET/CT, and XR segments, with growing market share internationally. UIH is recognized for its comprehensive product line and technological innovation, positioning itself as a world-class medical innovation leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, UIH achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.41 billion, representing a 23.52% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.97 billion, up 19.21%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 25.34 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 18.87 billion. R&D investment accounted for 16.81% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company has demonstrated steady growth in both domestic and international markets, with overseas revenue increasing by nearly 54%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: UIH differentiates itself through comprehensive, high-performance medical imaging and radiotherapy solutions that integrate advanced hardware, AI-powered software, and cloud-based platforms. Its products feature industry-leading innovations such as ultra-high field MRI, total-body PET/CT with 4D dynamic scanning, and integrated CT-guided radiotherapy accelerators. The company emphasizes precision diagnostics, intelligent workflows, and personalized treatment plans, aiming to improve clinical outcomes and patient experience. UIH also focuses on sustainable manufacturing and green product lifecycle management, aligning with global environmental goals.
